activation_reason: Platform/version/package-source details must be resolved from current Microsoft documentation before an executable adapter is enabled.
activation_requirements: current supported distribution versions are encoded explicitly
current .NET major/LTS availability is encoded per distribution version
architecture support is encoded per distribution/version/package source
package source ownership is explicit: distribution or Microsoft
repository signing and key provenance are encoded where a vendor feed is used
package identifiers are version-aware and verified against current Microsoft documentation
plan output exposes repositories, packages, privileges and verification commands
install-to-verify-to-install-again idempotency is tested on the exact target
safe removal ownership is known or remains fail-closed
non_inheritance_policy: Debian-family derivatives do not inherit Debian .NET support automatically
RHEL-compatible derivatives do not inherit RHEL .NET support automatically
package-manager compatibility alone never activates a target
cross-runtime availability does not imply host support
